summary: DAY expectations/execution review covered all 12 active-batch companies using cumulative primary evidence and current incremental company events. Normalized live valuation, consensus and crowding feeds remain non-canonical/unknown for T0 and therefore do not block baseline promotion. All 12 are lane-ready for Chief; execution views remain explicitly separate from Earth Score and are conservative where narrative sensitivity, concentration or capital intensity is high.
